newsitem.title: UK: Peru siege was only one incident of many worldwide.
newsitem.headline: Peru siege was only one incident of many worldwide.

text.p: The seizure of hostages at the Japanese embassy in Peru and the four-month siege which ended on Tuesday was one of the latest acts of political violence to gain worldwide headlines.
Here is a chronology of major guerrilla attacks over the last two years:
April 19 - Nearly 400 people taken to hospital in Yokohama, Japan, after mysterious gas released into the railway system.
April 19 - Car bomb destroys Federal Building in Oklahoma, United States, killing 168 people. Two American extreme rightists charged with causing the blast.

July 25 - Gas-canister bomb explodes on rush-hour underground train at crowded Saint-Michel Metro station in Paris, killing eight and injuring 86. This was first of eight bombings and attempted bombings in France blamed on Algerian Moslem extremists.
Jan 31 - In Sri Lanka, up to 90 die after a truck bomb explodes in Colombo when a suicide bomber rams the Central Bank.
Feb 9 - Huge bomb rocks London's Docklands area, killing two and injuring 100. Irish Republican Army (IRA) claims responsibility, ending 17-month ceasefire with Britain.
Feb 18 - Suspected IRA bomber blows himself up with own bomb on bus in London's Aldwych district -- one dead, nine wounded.
Feb 25 - Islamic Hamas suicide bomber blows up bus near Jerusalem's central bus station. Twenty-six people die in attack in Jerusalem and second assault in southern town of Ashkelon.
March 3-4 - Thirty more people, and a suicide bomber, killed by more Hamas bombs in Tel Aviv and Jerusalem.
June 11 - Bomb explodes on the Moscow underground, killing four people and injuring 12.
June 15 - IRA car bomb explodes at Manchester shopping mall during European soccer championship, injuring over 200 people.
June 25 - Fuel truck bomb kills 19 American soldiers and wounds nearly 400 people at a U.S. military complex in Khobar near the Saudi Arabian oil city of Dhahran.
July 20 - Basque separatist group ETA bombs Reus airport in northeastern Spain injuring 35 people.
July 24 - Two bombs rip through crowded commuter train in Colombo, killing at least 78 and injuring more than 450.
July 28 - Bomb explodes at concert during Atlanta Olympic Games, killing two and wounding 110.
Sept 23 - Four gunmen attack a Sunni Moslem mosque in the Pakistani city of Multan, killing at least 21 people.
Oct 7 - IRA bombs Britain's army headquarters in Northern Ireland, killing one and injuring 31 people.
Nov 10 - Thirteen mourners killed by bomb blast at a Moscow cemetery. Gangland feuding rather than political motive is blamed.
Nov 15 - Indian left-wing extremists kill 13 policemen and one civilian in a rocket attack in southern Andhra Pradesh state.
Nov 23 - Hijacked Ethiopian Airlines Boeing 767 crashes into the sea off the Comoro Islands, killing 125.
Dec 3 - Four people die and more than 90 are injured when a explosion rocks an underground station in Paris.
Dec 30 - Bomb devastates packed train in northwest Indian state of Assam, killing 300. Police blame Bodo separatist militants.
